meta.title: Statutory Verification APIs: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role and invoke the PAN, GST, bank, MSME, TAN, and IFSC statutory verification APIs
Repeat the API calls as an MDM / Master Data Team user
Compare refusal or absence for the first user with availability for the MDM user and record tenant RBAC configuration
Inspect statutory verification API authorization responses or network payloads
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role and invoke the PAN, GST, bank, MSME, TAN, and IFSC statutory verification APIs; Repeat the API calls as an MDM / Master Data Team user; Compare refusal or absence for the first user with availability for the MDM user and record tenant RBAC configuration; Inspect statutory verification API authorization responses or network payloads

args.need: sign in as users with and without the MDM / Master Data Team role, invoke the PAN, GST, bank, MSME, TAN, and IFSC statutory verification APIs for both users, and compare whether the APIs are refused or available

steps.note: No catalog step can perform role-specific sign-in or call and inspect these statutory verification APIs.
Assert that the browser remains free of an application error after the tester completes or reports the unavailable API check.
